remarks: Experience luxury living with this modern townhouse. The open floor plan is ideal for everyday living and entertaining featuring multiple sun-filled sitting areas that seamlessly connect to beautiful private outdoor spaces. At the center of the home is a gourmet kitchen with top of the line appliances, sleek cabinetry and high-end finishes. Large living/family room is equipped with gas fireplace for cosy evenings. Third floor features a spacious primary suite with walk-in closet, spa-like bathroom with soaking tub and glass shower. Two large bedrooms with custom built-ins provide flexibility for family, guests or home office needs. An additional bedroom and full bath are located on the first floor. Total sq-ft includes 264 sq-ft of finished basement. This home is not to be missed!
